name.seedreamBot.description: Name of the SeeDream image generator

description.prompt.message: Prompt for generating or editing an image

description.model.message: Model used for generating or editing images.

description.size.message: Sizes vary by model: 5.0 Pro supports 1K/1.5K/2K and auto for layers; 5.0 Lite supports 2K/3K/4K. Valid <width>x<height> values are also accepted.

description.watermark.message: Whether to add an AI watermark to the generated image. Enabled by default.

description.imageUrls.message: Upload references: Pro accepts up to 10, layer decomposition exactly 1, and other current models up to 14.

placeholder.prompt.message: Enter prompt, e.g., a white Siamese cat

button.confirmContinue.description: Confirm button on the capability-conflict prompt

button.cancelSwitch.description: Cancel button on the capability-conflict prompt

message.startTaskFailed.message: Task initiation failed, please contact the administrator:

message.usedUp.message: Your credits are exhausted, please purchase more to continue using

message.uploadImageExceed.message: You can upload at most {count} images

message.uploadImageError.message: Image upload failed, please try again later

message.referenceImageRequired.message: Upload at least one reference image to use Edit mode.
message.referenceImageRequired.description: Validation shown when Edit mode has no reference image

message.featureNotSupportedBody.message: The current selection does not support the following enabled settings: {fields}. Continuing will clear these settings.

message.featureRemovedNotice.description: Toast shown after the user confirms the capability-conflict prompt

model.seedream50.description: SeeDream 5.0 model option (supports image sets and streaming output)

model.seedream50pro.description: SeeDream 5.0 Pro model option (flagship single image; no image sets / streaming / web search)

name.maxImages.description: Number of images for generating image sets (max_images)

description.maxImages.message: Number of images generated in a single request (1-15). Set to 1 for single image mode; greater than 1 automatically enables image sets (sequential_image_generation=auto), maintaining character, style, and detail consistency across images. Only supports doubao-seedream-5.0 / 4.5 / 4.0; if reference images are uploaded, must satisfy (number of reference images + number generated) ≤ 15. Billing is based on the actual number of images generated.

description.seed.message: Random seed for reproducible results, range [-1, 2147483647]. -1 means random each time. Only supported by doubao-seedream-3.0-t2i and doubao-seededit-3.0-i2i.

description.guidanceScale.message: Prompt-following strength, range [1, 10]. Higher values follow the prompt more closely. Default 2.5 for doubao-seedream-3.0-t2i, 5.5 for doubao-seededit-3.0-i2i.

description.outputFormat.message: Image format is jpeg or png on Seedream 5.0 Pro/Lite. Decomposed layers are always PNG.

size.group.tier.description: Group label for the 1K-4K presets in the size dropdown

size.group.pixel.description: Group label for the pixel presets in the size dropdown
